title: Plan models and non-official plans
quote: Bottleneck: Harrod-Domar = limited savings; Mahalanobis = capital goods; wage-goods = food

boxes.title: Harrod-Domar logic
steps: Capital-output ratio **k** sets output per unit capital
Low COR → higher growth; high COR → slower even with high savings

boxes.title: Mahalanobis model
items: 4 sectors: capital goods, factory consumer goods, household/small-scale goods, services
Assumed a **closed economy** - no foreign trade; **import substitution**
Neglected **agriculture**; food shortages, **high inflation** by late **1950s**
Second Plan: target **4.5%**, achieved **4.21%** (⚠ other notes: **7.5%** / **4.1%**)
Steel: **Bhilai, Durgapur, Rourkela**; goal: **socialistic pattern of society** (IPR **1956**)

cards.title: Bombay Plan (1944)
lines: **8 Bombay industrialists**: J.R.D. Tata, G.D. Birla, Kasturbhai Lalbhai

boxes.title: P.C. Mahalanobis
items: Chaired **National Income Committee (1949)** → NSS; first round **1950-51**

items.what: **National Planning Committee** - set up under **Bose**, chaired by **Nehru**
Fifth Plan ended early; ==**Rolling Plan (1978-80)**== (Gunnar Myrdal concept)

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Second Plan key = **Mahalanobis**; wage-goods, Gadgil, CELP, Tendulkar are distractors (APPSC 2025)
**Solow** model: no Indian plan used it → trap
**Gandhian Constitution for Free India** = Shriman Narayan Agarwal (RPSC 2018)
Visvesvaraya = double in a decade; Bombay = treble in 15 years
